column1: # Upstream changes this fork has ruled on; `npm run check:upstream` reads this file.
# One per line, tab-separated: upstream ref, verdict, reason.
#   ref       #1234 for a PR, or a commit sha (7+ hex) for a commit with no PR
#   verdict   ours      CLIde has it: taken by hand or built its own way
#             refused   never take; the reason says why
#             declined  the fork diverged by choice; revisit only if ours proves worse in use
#             deferred  wanted; an open docs/TODO.md item owns it
# A cherry-pick made with `git cherry-pick -x`, or a commit with an `Upstream: #1234`
# footer, is found in git and needs no line here.
